== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-24-Wipe_Them_Out_All_Of_Them.png]]), the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-wipethemoutallofthem-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip (2013) show the original words (see [[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V)]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. The list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s [Permanent Weapon] destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch R8-U run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
